design.comparison_rule: At each comparison minute: delta = intervention - matched counterfactual for MAP, SBP, output Q, delivery and the effective deficit. Pressure improves when delta MAP > 0, worsens when < 0; perfusion improves when delta delivery > 0, worsens when < 0 (at equal demand the effective deficit then moves the other way or stays 0); a delta within 1e-9 of its scale is no change. Classes: PRESSURE_AND_PERFUSION_IMPROVE; PRESSURE_NONIMPROVING_WITH_PERFUSION_IMPROVEMENT; PRESSURE_IMPROVING_WITH_PERFUSION_WORSENING; PRESSURE_UNCHANGED_WITH_PERFUSION_WORSENING; NO_PERFUSION_CHANGE; PRESSURE_AND_PERFUSION_WORSEN. Only the last rejects (for the red cells named PRBC_CAUSES_PRESSURE_AND_PERFUSION_WORSENING); a pressure fall alone never does.
design.demand_rule: Demand 1.0 and 1.1 are filtered separately, each on its own retained units; a pressure / tone point is ROBUST_ACROSS_DEMAND with survivors at both, DEMAND_1_0_ONLY / DEMAND_1_1_ONLY at one, DEMAND_INCOMPATIBLE at neither. Diagnostic only: robustness is not required.

A.text: untreated 57m at 120: 40 <= SBP <= 70 and 30 <= MAP <= 50 mmHg

B.text: untreated 72f at 120: 60 <= SBP <= 95 and 45 <= MAP <= 70 mmHg

C.comparator: P1 (L1: L2 without the crystalloid, same blood set, same elapsed time)
C.text: crystalloid against its matched same-time untreated counterfactual: no PRESSURE_AND_PERFUSION_WORSEN at the comparison times; a zero or negative pressure change with improving perfusion is kept

D.text: first PRBC unit against L3 without it: no PRBC_CAUSES_PRESSURE_AND_PERFUSION_WORSENING at the comparison times

E.text: second PRBC unit against L3 without it: the same rule; no size relation to unit 1 is required

F.text: definitive management (haemostasis, sustained adequacy), both cases, at 120: 90 <= SBP <= 140 and 65 <= MAP <= 105 mmHg; no DBP envelope

G.text: T_abs within [1.0, 2.0] at every minute of the clinical haemorrhage scenarios (a broad physiological exploration envelope, not an SVR range); synthetic probes reported separately

H.text: when the effective deficit is zero the acute tone resolves: with the accepted one-step lag, every minute m with deficit(m) = 0 gives T_abs(m + 1) = 1 to numerical precision; no time constant or memory tolerance

I.text: the candidate keeps FD-LAC and L3 adequacy (P2I-2AD's rules, unchanged) under its own tone; a pressure / tone point with zero FD-LAC-compatible candidates at a compatible demand is CROSS_DOMAIN_INCOMPATIBLE there; no minimum retained share

faculty.afterload: PRIMARY a = 0.3, the provisional reference, not approved; a = 0.1 and 0.5 SENSITIVITY_ONLY, reported after the primary filter for the qualitative stability of its conclusions
faculty.demand: 1.0 and 1.1 carried separately; robustness across them is not a hard criterion; neither is approved
faculty.envelopes: A-I as frozen in ENVELOPES: case / scenario educational calibration envelopes, not universal thresholds; no DBP envelope; pressures above arrival are not pathological by themselves
faculty.gain: g = 0 DIAGNOSTIC_NO_RESPONSE_REFERENCE; PRIMARY g = 0.25, 0.5, 1.0; SENSITIVITY_ONLY g = 1.5, 2.0, never rescuing a primary region; no g FACULTY_APPROVED (g > 1 is not declared impossible)
faculty.hr: HR is a diagnostic in P2J-3 (P2I-2AK A-F under the changed DO2 / D); never a pressure filter unless a structural contradiction appears; pressure -> HR stays deferred
faculty.normalization: ACCEPTED: T_abs = 1 + g s, T = (1 + g s) / (1 + g s0), s0 the patient's modelled arrival acute signal; T = 1 means tone relative to that patient's arrival state; T_abs is an internal modelled vasoconstrictor coordinate, not a measured absolute SVR; no universal normal s0 or premorbid SVR
faculty.output: post-resuscitation Q about 1.4-1.8 x arrival is not rejected for being above 1: Q = 1 is the shocked arrival, not a normal resting output; BloodState and pump calibration are not reopened for it
faculty.scope: shadow only; no final tone or afterload approval, pressure -> HR reconnection, RR calibration, consciousness recalibration, collapse activation, GI or second-family migration, runtime integration or legacy fitting; BloodState, D, lactate constraints, RR, the P2J-1 mapping and the HR latent ranges unchanged
faculty.timing: ACCEPTED: the instantaneous target with the explicit one-step lag; no tone memory, no D-driven vascular memory, no tone time constant (reconsidered only if later cross-domain behaviour requires it)

design.identifiability_rule: Computed on the primary filter, never from the faculty's support decisions: a quantity is WELL_CONSTRAINED only with an authored observation fixing it (none exists after arrival); PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED when the faculty pressure envelopes alone (A-F, before I) leave one primary gain without survivors at a demand while another keeps some; POORLY_IDENTIFIED when the envelopes remove candidates differently across gains without emptying one; NON_IDENTIFIABLE when they remove the same candidates at every gain. The afterload point reads the same rule across a = 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.5 at the primary gains (sensitivity). The T_abs trajectory follows the gain; the pressure / output composite is bounded at 120 by A, B and F while output is never observed.
design.order_rule: Fixed before any count, cheapest first: the support (a table lookup), a structural guard (a run that stops or meets T's guard), G and H (read on every minute already rebuilt; G holds analytically for g <= 1 since T_abs = 1 + g s <= 1 + g), A and B (one P1 trajectory per case), F (P4), C (a P2 / P1 pair per crystalloid point, the most trajectories), D and E (P4 against its counterfactuals), I last (FD-LAC re-read: the most expensive). Every rule is evaluated for every candidate; the first failure in ORDER is the counted one, every failure and every pair of failures is reported too.
design.policy: Shadow only. P2J-2's committed record and machinery; legacy pressure never read (no shadow, legacy adapter or family-engine import), the P2F region never consumed (P2FGuard), no envelope changed after a count, sensitivity points never rescue a primary candidate, HR never a filter, pressure -> HR not reconnected, nothing approved.
design.verdict_rule: EMPTY when no primary candidate survives at either demand (then nothing else runs: no sensitivity, no HR). READY when: some primary candidate survives; A, B, F hold and C, D, E show no pressure and perfusion contradiction for the survivors (by the filter); G and H hold on every primary trajectory of the survivors; a non-empty FD-LAC region remains for some primary gain; no SIMULATION rejection among the primary trajectories; the comparators change only their intervention; the reconstruction equals the core on the validation runs; the retained units and P2J-2's trajectory tables are reproduced; pressure -> HR stays 0 in the primary HR profile; nothing is approved. Otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing check.
